goal: Repair neural URL behavior generalization without target-family training examples, model scaling, or claiming C5 rule-head outputs as neural learning.

confirmed_parent_result.claim: architecture repair confirmed; neural negative transfer remains

H1_field_path_shortcut.test: rewrite held-out input.origin tokens to the training primitive path input.endpoint without changing values or labels

H2_protocol_novelty.test: stratify query accuracy by https/http/ftp/ws/invalid and explicit default port
H2_protocol_novelty.support_threshold: unseen ws or explicit-port strata at least 15pp below seen schemes

H3_episode_binding_failure.test: invert every visible episode output and query label while keeping URL values fixed
H3_episode_binding_failure.support_threshold: inverted-label accuracy below 65% indicates family/query shortcut rather than trace binding

H4_gated_checkpoint_selection.test: compare current gated-selection checkpoint with a fixed-size candidate selected only by neural validation accuracy
H4_gated_checkpoint_selection.support_threshold: +5pp held-out neural agreement from neural-only selection

candidate_interventions_if_supported: canonicalize every parsed URL field to a source-language-neutral url.value semantic slot while retaining an optional provenance path
train with episode-consistent label permutation so fixed family mappings cannot minimize loss
select checkpoints by neural-only validation score; evaluate C5 separately
add detached scheme/hostname/effective-port primitive programs but no url_scheme_downgrade examples

decision_policy.pilot: Run one training seed only after a diagnostic hypothesis is supported.
decision_policy.confirmation: Freeze the successful intervention before generating at least two new data seeds.
decision_policy.failure: If the fixed-size model still cannot bind URL components from traces, classify an architectural capacity/inductive-bias bottleneck and test a set-comparison head rather than bulk data.
